subject: Your dog's first 28 days with us
preview_text: See the progress your pup has made since starting PupShape — it's more than you think.
body_paragraphs: Rover's collar is a little looser. The vet bill is a little lower. And the guilt? Already fading. You've been on PupShape for 28 days — that's a full month of showing up for your best friend.

Here's what you've actually done: You've logged 28 days of meals, walked through 4 weeks of custom exercise plans, and hit at least one weight milestone. That's not just a start — it's momentum. Every one of our 110+ dogs that lost 15% in 8 weeks started right here, right where you are.

Remember the before photo you snapped on day one? It's time to snap another. Open the app and hit the 'Progress' tab — you'll see a side-by-side timeline that makes this real. That photo is the proof your dog is healthier, happier, and moving better.

Take 60 seconds right now to upload a new photo. Seeing the difference will stick with you longer than any number on a scale. P.S. — The dogs who log a second photo by day 30 are 3x more likely to hit their goal weight. Don't leave this one on the table.
